name: exec-workspace
description: Guided, question-and-answer assistants for a Riven executive's Claude workspace. Includes exec-setup (install Pulse + Collective on your Claude), exec-guide (learn how to use the tools, the start/end-session habit, and the Collective web app — saved conversations you can share with another exec), exec-optimize (tune your Claude Code toward the proven Riven setup — inefficiencies, skills/MCP, and a security sweep — without removing your work), and exec-remind (drop a dated reminder on your own Microsoft To Do). Skills-only; no MCP server, no token needed.
